title: Dereth Town Tour - Eastwatch and Egg Orchard scratch

sites.name: Egg Orchard portals (Shattered Outlands glacier valley)

shots.standingOrder: Orbit the clifftop outpost at a steady 100 m radius and 28 m above its plateau, sweeping from the landward south-west out over the frozen shore and the sea; keep both towers in frame and stay 50 m clear of every roof.
shots.notes: Establishing + water: the camera starts SW over the island (ground 139) looking NE across the outpost to the open sea horizon, and swings ccw to SSE where it hangs 198 m above the sea and frozen shore, the town perched on its 170 m ice cliff. WBT get-height every 1 s: AGL 58.8-198 m; camera z 198 = 1.65 m above the tower tips (196.35) but never closer than 50 m horizontally to any structure; vmax 8.1 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Circle low and slow around the Life Stone and the swirling town portal at 12 m and 3 m up; keep both in frame and stay 6 m from each.
shots.notes: Magic FX: purple Portal to Town Network swirl (setup 0x020001B3 on the glowing blue stone base 0x020019E3 at 14103.53,46154.79) and the Life Stone (14092.93,46157.13) orbited from NE round to SSE, front-lit by the morning sun with the west Scrivener tower behind. Orbit centre is the midpoint, so the camera stays 6.6 m+ from both. WBT: ground 170 everywhere (AGL 3.0), query-radius 6 m around every 1 s sample = 0 statics; nearest structures 20 m; vmax 1.9 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Push slowly up the frozen valley floor toward the three red Egg Orchard portals; keep the middle portal centred and stay 3 m above the ice.
shots.notes: Effect shot before the dungeon: three red portal swirls (setup 0x020005D5, 7 m discs) - West 12910.98,47553.81 / Mid 12923.83,47556.72 / East 12940.19,47553.42 - between giant spikes (0x02000AC0, 7.8 m), glowing mucor and a mushroom tree that erupts grey ash (0x02000AC4), blue-ice walls rising 100-180 m behind. Push 48 m -> 15 m along x 12923.83 from the south, sun behind the camera. WBT get-height: AGL 2.6-5.2 m; query-radius 6 m around every sample = 0 statics; the spikes flank the line of sight 3.8 m and 4.4 m off it; camera stops 4.2 m short of the low rock shelf 0x02000F7D and 2.8 m above it.

shots.standingOrder: Thread the toxic-vent tunnels of the lowest level at speed, banking through every bend, then burst into the egg chamber; keep 1 m from walls and vent spouts; green gas may be faded.
shots.notes: HERO. Floor Z -60 (bottom level), 16 cells, 75.5 m: corridor south -> right-angle west past a green gas vent -> 45-degree bend SW -> T-junction south -> bend west -> across the north edge of the south egg room (eggs 3-4 m to the left) -> right-angle north through its doorway vestibule -> right-angle west past a second vent -> bend NW -> straight north between two staggered vents -> into the west egg chamber (hive glowing 10 m to the left, eggs right). Verified offline with the page's own planIndoorPath + fpv-corridor build on a graph rebuilt from the EnvCell/Environment DAT records: peak 5.9 m/s, min 2.2 m/s, no overspeed, bank up to 32 deg, camera 1.4-3.2 m above the floor; wall clearance min 1.01 m (45-degree bends), median 1.8 m; vent clearance 1.0-1.35 m at camera height (top flares 1.8 m); eggs 1.8 m+; hive never closer than 7 m.

shots.standingOrder: Push slowly in on the glowing toxic hive at the heart of the egg chamber over the cluster of olthoi eggs; stay 1.5 m from the hive and the eggs; green fog may be faded.
shots.notes: Effect shot: the toxic hive (0x02000F97, 5.6 x 5.4 x 2.3 m, green fog + throbbing 8.7 m green halo) in cell 0x002B0106 with three enchanted olthoi eggs (0x02000AE1) just in front, in green ghost-haze (0x02000693). Camera 10.7 m -> 4.9 m from the hive centre (1.75 m from its edge at the end), z -56.1 -> -57.1 (3-4 m above the floor of the 12 m tall chamber), starting in cell 0x002B010C.
